Title: Simplify safe_join path checks

Description:
posixpath.normpath already collapses `..` segments, so the explicit `..` checks in safe_join are redundant. This makes the condition shorter and easier to read.

</untrusted-pr-94db27d03e2a>

   214                      in _windows_device_files
   215                      for p in part.split("/")
   216                  )
   217              )
   218          ):
   219              return None
